# TwisterTools

> 100% free, fast, privacy-first, browser-native online utilities and calculation engines.

TwisterTools is a rapidly expanding, privacy-first ecosystem of hundreds of client-side web tools, calculators, generators, and converters designed to execute entirely in the user's browser memory (RAM). By utilizing modern browser-side technologies—including native JavaScript, WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and the Web Cryptography API—TwisterTools guarantees zero-latency execution without transmitting user files, sensitive data, code, or cryptographic keys to remote servers.
## Core Architecture & Privacy Principles

- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All processing runs locally in browser memory. No telemetry logs, no database persistence of inputs, and zero data uploads.
- **Zero Server Uploads**: PDF manipulation, image conversions, cryptographic hashing, and code transformations happen entirely on the user's local CPU/GPU.
- **Instant Execution**: Bound strictly by local device performance, completely eliminating network latency and server queue bottlenecks.
- **Unrestricted Access**: Every utility across all 13 categories is accessible without subscriptions, usage limits, paywalls, or accounts.
